definitions.gloss: irreplaceable; one of a kind; having no substitute
definitions.explanation: Describes something or someone that cannot be replaced, because no substitute of equal value exists. The phrase is essentially a fixed collocation built on {代|か}わり ('substitute, replacement'), and is used to express deep emotional value, especially for people and meaningful things.

examples.japanese: {代|か}わりのない{友|とも}だち。
{家族|かぞく}は{私|わたし}にとって{代|か}わりのない{存在|そんざい}だ。
examples.english: My family is irreplaceable to me.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}{使|つか}ってきたこの{万年筆|まんねんひつ}は、{私|わたし}にとって{代|か}わりのない{大切|たいせつ}なものです。
examples.english: This fountain pen I've used for many years is a precious, irreplaceable thing to me.

notes:
A fixed attributive phrase built from {代|か}わり ('substitute, replacement') + の (genitive linker) + ない (negative of ある). Literally 'having no substitute'. Used almost exclusively before a noun to describe people, relationships, or objects of deep personal value.

Grammatically an adjectival phrase; unlike a true na-adjective it cannot take な before the noun, and it does not inflect freely like an i-adjective (you do not say {代|か}わりのなく). For predicate use, speakers typically rephrase: {代|か}わりのない{存在|そんざい}だ (predicate) or {代|か}わりはない (statement).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代|か}わりのない{人|ひと}: an irreplaceable person
- {代|か}わりのない{存在|そんざい}: an irreplaceable presence/being
- {代|か}わりのない{時間|じかん}: irreplaceable time
- {代|か}わりのない{思|おも}い{出|で}: irreplaceable memories
- {代|か}わりのない{命|いのち}: a life that cannot be replaced

SIMILAR WORDS:
- かけがえのない: irreplaceable, precious — a near-synonym, often slightly more literary/emotional
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}{無二|むに}: one and only; unique — stronger, more formal
- {二|に}つとない: one of a kind, like no other — emphasizes rarity more than emotional bond
- {貴重|きちょう}な: precious, valuable — broader; emphasizes value, not uniqueness
- {代|か}わりのない vs かけがえのない: nearly interchangeable. かけがえのない is slightly more poetic and common in set phrases like かけがえのない{命|いのち} ('precious life'); {代|か}わりのない feels slightly more conversational.
